question_en: A ground-fault detection system has intermittent alarms. What evidence should guide the maintenance decision?
options: Field assessment and diagnostic test results, followed by verification of the selected repair.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: B-11.06 links troubleshooting to field assessment, test results, appropriate repair/replacement and verification.
explanation_es: B-11.06 vincula el diagnóstico con evaluación de campo, resultados de prueba, reparación/reemplazo apropiado y verificación.

question_en: An AC generating system has unstable output after maintenance. What information should guide troubleshooting?
options: A documented malfunction description together with field assessment and diagnostic test results.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: B-12.02 requires malfunction history plus assessment and diagnostic results to determine the source of a problem.
explanation_es: B-12.02 exige historial de la falla más evaluación y resultados de diagnóstico para determinar su origen.

question_en: A renewable-energy system requires maintenance. Which evidence-based approach best matches the RSOS?
options: Use the documented condition and diagnostic results to determine maintenance, then verify operation after service.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: B-13.02 describes maintenance as assessment/diagnosis, appropriate service and verification of operation.
explanation_es: B-13.02 describe el mantenimiento como evaluación/diagnóstico, servicio apropiado y verificación de operación.

question_en: Maintenance results for Task B-14 differ significantly from commissioning records. What is the correct evaluation basis?
options: Previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: B-14.02 requires maintenance results to be evaluated against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-14.02 exige evaluar resultados contra datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: A three-phase transformer test result differs from previous maintenance records. What should guide the maintenance decision?
options: Analysis against previous records, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: B-15.06 requires comparison of transformer test results with previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-15.06 exige comparar resultados con datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: Inspection identifies damaged support components and loose fittings in a raceway system. Which maintenance decision matches C-16.06?
options: Repair or replace damaged components and correct loose components according to applicable requirements.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: C-16.06 requires damaged components to be repaired or replaced and loose components corrected.
explanation_es: C-16.06 exige reparar o reemplazar componentes dañados y corregir componentes flojos.

question_en: A wiring device was replaced but the branch circuit remains intermittent. What evidence is needed before the work is considered complete?
options: Post-repair test results, verification of correct operation and updated documentation for changes made.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: C-17.04 requires post-repair testing, verification of function and documentation updates.
explanation_es: C-17.04 exige pruebas posteriores, verificación de funcionamiento y actualización de documentación.
